query: What is the policy for prorated software license refunds?
context: Enterprise SaaS licenses are eligible for prorated refunds if cancelled within 14 calendar days of billing. Refunds are calculated on remaining unused whole days. Custom enterprise tiers with dedicated SLAs are strictly non-refundable.
ground_truth: Prorated refunds are available within 14 calendar days of billing based on unused whole days. Custom enterprise tiers with dedicated SLAs are completely non-refundable.

query: How many failed login attempts trigger an automated account lockout?
context: Our zero-trust security policy locks out an account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 15-minute window. Account lockout duration is 30 minutes, or immediate upon 2FA SMS verification.
ground_truth: Accounts are locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within 15 minutes. The lockout lasts 30 minutes unless unlocked via 2FA SMS verification.

query: What is the guaranteed uptime and penalty for Tier 1 Enterprise services?
context: Tier 1 Enterprise services carry a 99.95% monthly uptime SLA. If monthly uptime drops below 99.95% but stays above 99.0%, clients receive a 10% credit. If uptime drops below 99.0%, clients receive a 25% credit.
ground_truth: Tier 1 guarantees a 99.95% monthly uptime. Falling between 99.0% and 99.95% issues a 10% credit; falling below 99.0% issues a 25% service credit.

query: Where is customer personal data stored and how is it encrypted at rest?
context: All European customer data is partitioned across eu-central-1 and eu-west-1. Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 with customer-managed keys rotated annually. Backups are retained in write-once-read-many (WORM) compliant S3 vaults.
ground_truth: European customer data resides in eu-central-1 and eu-west-1, encrypted at rest using AES-256 with annually rotated keys, backed up in WORM-compliant storage.

query: What is the response time guarantee for Severity 1 production incidents?
context: Severity 1 (Critical Outage) incidents require a 15-minute initial response by an on-call site reliability engineer 24/7. Hourly status updates must be published to the client status dashboard until resolution.
ground_truth: Severity 1 incidents mandate a 15-minute initial response 24/7 by an SRE and hourly status page updates until resolved.
